cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The new P4 contract, data-operation, subset-filter, workflow-runtime, and dataset-discovery assertions are red at the verified P3 baseline because the requested declarations, execution paths, closed filters, and chain tool do not exist yet.
impact: The P4 slice is intentionally red before production implementation; the baseline implementation remains unchanged.
lesson: Freeze typed declarations and their red assertions before implementing the shared data-operation seam.

cause: Affected paths differ from the frozen Context Pack and require an explicit scope correction.
lesson: Record the exact old and new manifest identities before correcting development scope.

cause: An explicit Context Pack rescope replaced the affected-path snapshot.
lesson: Correct scope only through an audited, new frozen manifest generation.

cause: The first start invocation supplied dotted tag v1.8.8; the formal CLI rejected it before creating a line because tags must be normalized identifiers.
impact: The rejected invocation created no development line; a second invocation with normalized tags created the intended p4-data-management line.
lesson: Use normalized identifier tags when starting a formal line and treat a rejected start as no line creation.

cause: The first P0 lineage extension validated sibling source branches against one mutable global visible-column set; reshape changed that set and the later subset could no longer see scaled from first.
impact: The P0 lineage execution case could not compile the complete P4 consuming-operation chain.
lesson: Compile column visibility from the declared source branch; sibling transforms must not mutate one another's schema context.

cause: The generic data-operation adapter forwarded the composition-only source commitment into DataTransformSpecV1.parameters, where the closed service schema correctly rejected it.
impact: P4 data-operation steps with an explicit source commitment failed at runtime instead of executing through the typed service.
lesson: Strip composition-owned fields at the declaration/runtime boundary before constructing the typed service spec.

cause: The generic adapter initially passed the workflow compatibility field source_artifact_fingerprint into the closed data-operation parameter map.
impact: The first real transform-to-model execution stopped before persistence with an unsupported-parameter error.
lesson: Keep compatibility and composition metadata outside the typed transformation parameter namespace.

cause: The generic adapter read DataTransformPreview.row_count even though the typed preview exposes row_count_before and row_count_after.
impact: The real transform-to-model path failed after preview and before returning a produced-dataset binding.
lesson: Use the exact typed preview fields at the service seam and retain before/after row evidence separately.

cause: While inserting the generic data-operation adapter, the existing exploration branch's return was temporarily displaced, causing P0 exploration results to become None.
impact: Three existing P0 workflow seam assertions failed before the branch placement was corrected.
lesson: Keep existing branch returns structurally adjacent to their branch and rerun the seam immediately after generic dispatch insertion.

cause: The first dataset-discovery implementation referenced Mapping without importing it in context_tools.py.
impact: The real list_project_datasets handler could not complete its artifact-index projection.
lesson: Run the provider handler test, not only tool-definition projection tests, after adding a bounded evidence reader.

cause: A temporary hard-coded exclusion of p4_test.injected from STEP_PRODUCES_DATASET was introduced to test whether declaration injection reached the derived projection.
impact: The injection assertion failed at the expected derived-set membership check; the mutation was restored immediately.
lesson: Declaration injection catches hard-coded projection sets when the test asserts every live derived view.

cause: A temporary replacement of lag.shift with a constant zero series was introduced to test declaration-derived values.
impact: The lag assertion failed on the expected missing/shifted value, and the implementation was restored.
lesson: Value-level assertions detect a hard-coded lag output even when output columns and persistence shape remain correct.

cause: A temporary hard-coded false guard suppressed the unresolved detail check in list_project_datasets.
impact: The unknown run/node detail assertion failed because the handler would have silently returned no identity; the mutation was restored immediately.
lesson: A bounded discovery tool must fail visibly for requested identities it cannot resolve rather than omit them.

cause: The repository-root full backend command completed with 4838 passed, 5 skipped, 1 xfailed, and 20 failures. All 20 failures are code-execution/sandbox tests reporting sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted in this managed terminal.

impact.product_scope: P4 focused/relevant suites remain green; the full-suite failures are outside P4 paths and require host containment evidence.

lesson: Classify managed-terminal sandbox-exec denial as an environment gate gap and obtain the separate host gate before claiming full release verification.

cause: The required host gate was run outside the managed terminal after the managed terminal classified sandbox-exec as unavailable.
lesson: Use the host gate to close a managed-terminal containment gap; preserve the managed full-suite result separately rather than adding invalid test ignores.

cause: The final registry smoke used a non-existent OperationRegistry.list_operations method and exited before completing the inventory assertion.
impact: The review command did not modify production code or tests; the query was corrected to the live operation_ids registry method.
lesson: Inspect the live registry API before writing a final smoke query and treat a failed review command as an explicit process event.

cause: The review grep included intentional negative-test assertions for data.sort, so the shell guard exited even though production implementation paths contained no data.sort registration.
impact: The review shell check stopped before its final PASS message; no source, test, registry, or formal state was changed.
lesson: Scope negative vocabulary scans to production paths and verify forbidden identities through the live registry assertions separately.

cause: Independent review confirmed that P4 declarations, live registry projections, closed schemas, branch-local source validation, typed runtime adaptation, and persisted child lineage remain aligned.

impact.known_limit: P7 frontend/browser acceptance remains intentionally outside this line.
impact.review: PASS: eleven P4 operation identities are present in the live registry and declaration-derived projections; data.sort is absent from production registration.
impact.validation: PASS: focused and relevant suite is green; declaration injection, lag value mutation, and dataset-detail omission mutations were caught and restored.

lesson: Keep the declaration seam, typed operation service, and persisted graph binding under one review boundary; report host-containment evidence separately from managed-terminal failures.

cause: The first self-review event payload used unsupported preventability value not_applicable and the formal CLI rejected it before append.
impact: No invalid event entered the hash chain; the corrected self-review event was appended with preventability unknown.
lesson: Use the formal event vocabulary exactly and validate a review payload before treating it as recorded evidence.

cause: The final focused and relevant P4 verification completed after the independent review.

impact.command_scope: P4 data management, data-operation regressions, feature recipes, capability contracts/inventory, context tools, generic workflow, and workflow seam
impact.host_gate: Previously completed with GATE PASSED; backend 4887 passed, 2 skipped, 1 xfailed; frontend and typecheck passed.

lesson: Keep the final focused/relevant result alongside the separate host full-gate result so managed-terminal containment gaps cannot be mistaken for product failures.

cause: P4 implementation, formal event verification, focused/relevant tests, managed full-backend classification, and the separate host full gate are complete at the verified P3 baseline.

impact.deferred: Frontend/browser acceptance and P7 integration remain intentionally deferred.

lesson: A P4 line closes only after the declaration seam, runtime, persistence evidence, test gates, formal log, and explicit P7 boundary are all recorded together.
